label: bug
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The ExportButton component sets a busy state when an export starts and clears it only if the export succeeds. However, if the export fails (throws an error), the busy state remains true, causing the button to stay disabled and greyed out. To fix this, the busy state should be cleared in a finally block or an equivalent error handler to ensure the button becomes clickable again regardless of success or failure.
